mtlDescription: An MTL's maps, relative to the MTL's own folder: the map is joined to it before it is normalised, and climbing is measured from the model's folder. material is the OBJ's mtllib as written, materialAt where that normalises to. No map here holds a blank: the server also registers each blank-separated token of a map that looks like a file of its own, which the client does not. Read by tests/unit/loaders/mtlTexturePaths.test.js and tests/unit/Service/ModelDependencyResolverTest.php.
